aerospace.title: Reforestation Robot
aerospace.subtitle: RoboHacks · Feb. 2025 · Unexpected Expedition Award · 5th Overall

Autonomous seed-planting robot built in 24 hours at RoboHacks (Feb. 2025) using recycled materials for the structure: a cardboard chassis, plastic bottles, and a folded paper seed dispenser.

Won the Unexpected Expedition Award and placed 5th overall.

robotics.title: ResQ-Link
robotics.subtitle: UpStart 2026 · Feb. 2026 · Digital System for Disaster Management
robotics.details:
In Montreal, analog paper triage tags contribute to a 30% triage error rate, $1.7B in annual malpractice losses, and 10.5-hour average ER wait times. ResQ-Link replaces paper tags with a zero-power passive NFC bracelet.

• Inductive copper coil (no battery required), passive NFC chip, medical-grade silicone band designed for IP68 with translucent overmolded seal
• SmartTriage companion dashboard — real-time bracelet location maps, tag management (Morgue / Immediate / Delayed / Minor), registered staff tracking
• Offline-mesh data sync so patient data reaches the hospital even when cellular fails
• Business model: hardware 'Blade' at $1.50/unit + software 'Razor' SaaS at $10k–$50k/facility/year

Targeting a $750k seed round for a MUHC 5,000-unit pilot, with Health Canada Class I/II certification and Quebec 'Buy Local' procurement priority.

robotics.title: Nursie
robotics.subtitle: Best Use of ElevenLabs · ConUHacks X · Jan. 2026
robotics.details:
On-premises AI nurse assistant prototype for Quebec long-term care facilities (CHSLDs), built at ConUHacks X (Jan. 2026): 38 commits in 16.5 hours.

Falls among seniors (65+) have risen 47% between 2008 and 2019. Nursie targets the gap between an unwitnessed fall and the moment staff respond.

• A TI IWR6843 mmWave radar tracks residents and detects falls with no camera in the room
• A floor vibration sensor picks up impacts; an alert fires when the radar or the floor sensor reports a fall
• Two ESP32 boards on FreeRTOS publish raw sensor values to ROS 2 over Wi-Fi with micro-ROS
• A Flask backend runs the fall logic, scores each event's confidence, and escalates with a phone call (Twilio) and a dashboard alert
• Gemini triages events, ElevenLabs gives residents a voice assistant, and MongoDB keeps each resident's history
• An Apple Watch app posts vital signs every second

Next steps: require two sensors to agree before an alert, keep all data on the facility network, and replace the simulated door sensor with real hardware. Won Best Use of ElevenLabs at ConUHacks X.

software.title: Trace
software.subtitle: HackHarvard 2026 · 1st Place, Best Data-Driven Agent (Chalk Prize) · Oct. 2026
software.details:
Autonomous AI disaster agent that warns people before a wildfire or storm surge reaches their home — address by address, not whole evacuation zones. Won 1st place for Best Data-Driven Agent (Chalk Prize) at HackHarvard 2026. Covers wildfires in LA and Ventura counties and hurricanes on the US East Coast.

WHY WE BUILT IT
While interning at Tesla in Nevada, our team lived through several nearby fires. Coming from Canada and the East Coast, we had no idea whether we were in danger and couldn't find reliable information on where the fires were spreading. Trace turns satellite and environmental data into warnings people can actually act on.

WHAT IT DOES
• Every 15 minutes, pulls NASA satellite fire detections, national fire perimeters, NWS warnings, NOAA hurricane advisories and tide gauges, and hourly wind, humidity and fuel dryness
• For each home, estimates hours until the hazard arrives from distance, wind direction and local sensitivity, then decides: watch, warn, or evacuate
• Texts over iMessage (via Photon) at the first warning; an ElevenLabs voice agent calls at evacuate and answers questions about the fire, its direction, and which way to go
• Time-aware router plans the fastest safe route with turn-by-turn directions, a map, and the latest time to leave — and says so if no safe route exists
• Two-way conversation: text NOW for a route, WINDOW for when to leave, STATUS for the latest, LEFT once you're out
• Web app replays 5 real fires and 4 hurricanes hour by hour with shader-rendered fire spread, 3D buildings that burn on the fire's clock, a thermal view, storm-surge flooding, and a live map of hot spots and Red Flag zones

HOW WE BUILT IT
• Burn-probability model over 806,000 grid cells from CAL FIRE perimeters, USGS terrain and LANDFIRE fuels (AUC 0.74 on unseen 2015–2025 fires vs 0.71 for fire history alone)
• Rothermel spread simulation on a 30 m grid with hourly wind and fuel moisture
• Parametric storm-surge model fitted on Sandy and Matthew, validated on Irma and Isabel against NOAA tide gauges
• Agent sees each event only as it was known at that hour, so replays never use hindsight; an LLM policy via Chalk's Model Gateway calls fire tools before deciding and distills its own mistakes into lessons
• Time-aware shortest-path search on OpenStreetMap road graphs that closes roads the fire or water will reach within a safety margin
• Ran on Chalk Sandboxes (24/7 alert loop + MCP server, web app, learning loop) with Chalk Evaluations for alert quality
• Safety-critical facts — routes, timing, steps — come from code, never invented by the LLM

RESULTS (no-hindsight replays)
• Warned 100% of destroyed homes across 600 households in the Eaton and Palisades fires, a median of 8.7 hours ahead
• 92% of Hurricane Sandy evacuation routes stayed clear of flooding, vs 60% for the fastest route (92% vs 65% for Irma)
• Spread simulation overlapped 85% of the real Palisades burn area and reached 99% of destroyed homes
• Surge rules evacuated 100% of flooded homes in time, a median of 30.6 hours ahead

WHAT WE LEARNED
Back every claim with data, especially when lives are at stake: honest evaluation showed simple distance rings still evacuate more people in time on two fires (92.5% vs 82.5%), and we report it.

software.title: CRM Outreach Tool
software.subtitle: Accenture · AOTC 2026 · Jan.–Apr. 2026
software.details:
Part of a pro-bono consulting engagement with a community of agriculture startups through Accenture's Accent on the Community program (Jan.–Apr. 2026). The details are under NDA. Our student team identified the key market segments, scored 9 new revenue activities on 5 criteria (technical feasibility, cost, operational ease, revenue and marketing potential), built a financial model and an operating plan with partnership targets and KPIs, and presented the recommendations to the client.

Fully integrated CRM outreach tool built for a community of agriculture startups, as part of Accenture's AOTC 2026 program.

• Manages contact lists across 3 audience segments (corporate, schools, institutions & media)
• Uses Google Gemini AI to generate personalized cold emails tailored to each contact's name, title, and organization — then sends them directly through the app
• Tracks every contact through the full sales pipeline with real-time Google Sheets sync
• Centralizes booking requests with auto-calculated revenue estimates — accept, refuse, or cancel reservations with one click, triggering a professional email to the client instantly

Total running cost: ~$0/month on free tiers.

software.title: Interview Assistant
software.subtitle: Brebeuf Hacks · Jan. 2024 · Voice AI
software.details:
Voice-based virtual interviewing assistant designed to help computer science students prepare for technical interviews, built at Brebeuf Hacks (Jan. 2024) in a team of 3.

The assistant presents personalized interview questions verbally, listens to the response, and evaluates it using NLP algorithms. Built with Python and an AI/NLP API.

Features a realistic spoken-word interface so students can practice verbal answers, not just type them.
